subdermal.name: CombAug Subdermal Armor Model 3
subdermal.description_main: An underskin armor system that makes you more resilient to damage.
subdermal.description_more: Consists of series of fiber meshes, armor plates and ballistics absorbers installed under the skin.
subdermal.description_looks: The system looks like a series of lines on your epidermis and some shapes under your skin.
subdermal.description_effect: Gives you some extra armor to reduce damage.

targeting_eye.name: GuardTech Optical Combat Assist Eye 2052
targeting_eye.description_main: A cybernetic eye that overlays targetting assistance in your field of vision.
targeting_eye.description_more: An artificial eye with a simple targeting computer and visual aid system.
targeting_eye.description_looks: A shiny, metal eye with a smooth, unearthy and pupilless surface.
targeting_eye.description_effect: Increases your accuracy with all weapons.

pistol_assist.name: Gunslinger Industries Quickdraw GunHero Arm
pistol_assist.description_main: An arm system that stabilizes pistol-level recoil, steadies aim and includes minor features for most pistols.
pistol_assist.description_more: Several minor systems that can be installed in meat or cyber arms to help uising pistols.
pistol_assist.description_looks: Hidden subdermally but some components can be installed as skin-mounted vents and other intimidating visuals.

mag_vest.name: TacWear 2032 Tactical Subdermal Vest
mag_vest.description_main: A tried and tested vest-like setup that is installed into the chest of the user.
mag_vest.description_more: A series of attachment points and underskin pockets. Comes with compatible shirt lines for easy access to the pockets.
mag_vest.description_looks: Some bumps on your chest and sides with piercing-like attachment points and clips. Pretty easy to conceal with a shirt.
